mentions.name: Kitten Word
mentions.description: A cat themed word puzzle game for Android and iOS that brings together the top word games in one place, with more games planned over time. AI was used to move fast across UI, level design, coding, and video production.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a cat themed word puzzle game with two friends.

It will have all the top word games in one place with more coming over time.

I always wanted to build games, and AI finally made it possible for us to move fast across UI, level design, coding, and even video production.

Creating an Android app of my favourite word game. Existing games are full of ads. Started coding, thanks again, thanks to AI.
